name: OmarBuilds
tagline: I build robots that you can build too.
description: OmarBuilds — 3D-printed robots, Dynamixel servos, Arduino and Python. Watch the builds on YouTube and get the files on Patreon.

patreon.blurb: Every build's STL files, Arduino & Python code and parts list live on Patreon. Files come with the Builder tier — but there's a free tier too.

tiers.name: Hobbyist
perks: Keeps the parts bucket topped up

builds.title: Doc Ock's Robot Claw
builds.summary: A four-fingered, Doc Ock–style claw that holds a globe and slowly spins it on your desk. 12 Dynamixel XL430 servos, an Arduino OpenRB-150, red LED filaments, and four pots to dial in speed, direction and finger offsets. Inspired by Mark Setrakian.

builds.title: The Leaper (Arc Raiders)
builds.summary: Building the Leaper from Arc Raiders. It already looks like one — the question is whether it'll jump.

builds.title: 3D-Printed Ray-Ban Sunglasses
builds.summary: Reverse-engineering and 3D printing a pair of $200 Ray-Bans — the same ones I wear in every video.

about: I'm Omar, a mechatronics engineer who builds robots on camera — 3D-printed, servo-driven, usually a little bit evil. Every build gets a full video on YouTube, and the files, code and parts list go on Patreon so you can build it too.
